title: alchemilla acutiloba subsp. speciosa
intro: Alchemilla acutiloba subsp. speciosa, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae, characterized by its rosy or pink flowers and deeply lobed foliage. The health benefits of Lady's Mantle include its ability to soothe menstrual cramps, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. Its therapeutic actions include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating a variety of conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, tannins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
